summary: Bitcoin remains stuck in consolidation around 60k with conflicting signals - monthly bullish breakout that stalled and daily bearish breakdown that's being retested. ETH underperforming with gas fees at historic lows despite ETF approval, with ETHUSD hanging on support. Solana meme coin cycle showing exhaustion after large drawdowns, with Duck having shorted from 170. Both hosts express frustration with current crypto Twitter environment and meme coin toxicity. Emphasis on trading psychology and sizing into high-conviction setups rather than static sizing. Weekly time frame identified as key for directional bias. Overall market sentiment neutral with uncertainty about direction.
